**The ask** (paste exactly what you typed to the Captain)

**The crew** (which workers or standing agents did it, any custom prompts)

**What came back** (the doc or change title, the commit, a screenshot if you have one)

**Time** (how long from ask to approve, and roughly what it cost in the Today page)

**Did it save you time?** Honest answer, including what went wrong.
